name: 终极地狱之轩辕传说
english_description: Internally identified as hell.local, part of the ES II engine family alongside es1_win/xkx2001/rzrmud in this collection, its master file's authorship trail running through 'for ES II mudlib' to 'Annihilator', 'Xiang for XKX', and 'Doing Lu for hell'. Two other archives in this collection also happen to carry 'Ultimate Hell' in their name (zjdyaryl and zjdyzj) — those belong to a separate branch of the 'Hell' lineage and are different games entirely, sharing only the coincidental title; all three have unrelated content.
